{{Top|leg}}
The '''hand-ballista''' (plural: '''hand-ballistae''') was a personal projectile weapon used by the [[Alanciari]], the [[Keshiri/Legends|Keshiri]] inhabitants of the continent [[Alanciar]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Kesh/Legends|Kesh]]. The weapon fired bolts at an enemy; the most inexpensive type of ammunition was a [[Glass/Legends|glass]] rod, while the more pricey included fragmenting [[Silver/Legends|silver]] bolts. Some models of hand-ballista had a rapid-fire function; the repeating version of the weapon was standard issue for the front-line [[Soldier/Legends|soldiers]] of Alanciar. The user of a hand-ballista was known as a ballisteer. However, after the [[Invasion of Alanciar|conquest]] of Alanciar by the [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] of the [[Lost Tribe of Sith]], the Alanciari were disarmed and their hand-ballistae burned.
